title: Direct boot on a demo edit deep link never fetches the edit payload — blank form (r2 fold 'edit deep-link boots with its payload' did not land)
evidence: client.gleam demo_entry_effects: `routes.Comparison(vid) -> [ demo_api.fetch_comparison( store, vid, load_comparison_ids(), ApiReturnedComparisonDetails, ), ] _ -> [] } effect.batch(list.append(base, route_eff))` — no `routes.VacancyEdit(id)` arm. enter_demo sets only the id: `// A deep-linked demo edit page needs its id set so the // get_for_edit response is accepted and the form can load. vacancy_edit_id: edit_id,`. modem.ffi.mjs do_init installs only click/popstate/push/replace listeners (no boot dispatch), so handle_browser_change's VacancyEdit branch (client.gleam:5264-5270 `demo_api.get_for_edit`) never runs at boot. model.initial() has `vacancy_edit_loading: False` and vacancy_edit.gleam:22-28 renders the form immediately when loading is False.
detail: A full-page load on /vacancies/v-maples/edit (refresh or shared link) boots demo mode but ApiReturnedVacancyForEdit never arrives: the edit page renders the empty initial form, not The Maples' data.
recommended_fix: Add a `routes.VacancyEdit(id) -> [demo_api.get_for_edit(store, id, ApiReturnedVacancyForEdit)]` arm to demo_entry_effects and set `vacancy_edit_loading: True` in enter_demo for that route.

title: Reset demo from a non-dashboard demo page strands the page on a permanent loading skeleton (r2 fold 'reset navigates home' did not land)
evidence: reset_demo: `#( Model( ..model, demo_store: Some(store), auth: Success(landlord), vacancies: Success(vacancies), dashboard_stats: Success(stats), vacancy_detail: NotAsked, leaderboard: NotAsked, application_detail: NotAsked, comparison_details: NotAsked, archived_vacancies: NotAsked, awaiting_list: NotAsked, notifications: NotAsked, toasts: [], ), demo_api.fetch_notifications(store, ApiReturnedNotifications), )` — route unchanged, only notifications refetched. application_detail.gleam:39-42: `case model.application_detail { NotAsked | Loading -> view_loading()` (same for vacancy_detail.gleam:25-26, archived_vacancies.gleam:49-50). The reset button renders on the persistent banner (shell.gleam:36-38) on every demo route.
detail: Clicking 'Reset demo' while on /vacancies/v-maples or an application detail page resets the data caches to NotAsked but neither navigates home nor refetches the current route — the page shows a skeleton forever.
recommended_fix: In reset_demo, navigate home (modem.push('/demo')) or dispatch the current route's demo fetches (get_detail/fetch_leaderboard/fetch_application_detail/fetch_archived) after re-seeding.

title: Demo exit to a public route retains demo data caches — after signup/login the real dashboard renders demo vacancies
evidence: Exit branch resets only three fields: `True -> handle_browser_change( Model( ..model, demo_mode: False, demo_store: None, auth: NotAsked, ), uri, route, )` — `vacancies`/`dashboard_stats`/`notifications` stay Success(demo fixtures). ApiReturnedLogin(Ok) (client.gleam:776-806) and ApiReturnedSignup(Ok) (651-682) set auth and call navigate_after_login without touching vacancies. The dashboard refetch is gated on NotAsked (client.gleam:5165-5166 `let eff = case route, updated_model.vacancies { routes.Dashboard, NotAsked ->`), so it never fires. The banner CTA is `attribute.href("/signup")` (demo_banner.gleam:35) and view_demo_settings_notice's CTA links /signup — the demo→signup funnel is the primary path.
detail: A landlord who tries the demo, clicks 'Create your vacancy →', and signs up lands on /dashboard still showing The Maples/2 Harbour Court with mock applicants as their own vacancies (no refetch until reload).
recommended_fix: On demo exit, reset the demo-populated caches (vacancies/dashboard_stats/notifications/vacancy_detail/leaderboard/application_detail/comparison_details/archived_vacancies) to NotAsked alongside demo_mode/demo_store/auth.
